frame.zodiac: Moves every longitude by the ayanamsha, about 24° today, and with it every sign, nakshatra and house
frame.ayanamsha: Moves every sidereal longitude alike, by the difference between the two ayanamshas: Lahiri's and Krishnamurti's part by about 6′
frame.ayanamshaBasis: Moves every sidereal longitude by the nutation in longitude, up to 17.2″
frame.node: Moves Rahu and Ketu by up to about 2° between the mean node and the true
frame.centre: Moves the Moon by up to about a degree and the planets by seconds: two hours on a tithi's end
frame.positions: Moves the Sun by about 21″ and Mercury by up to about 1′ between apparent and true places
frame.siddhanta: Replaces the sky: the text's planets stand up to degrees from the modern ones, and a limb's end moves by up to hours
frame.nakshatraScheme: Changes the nakshatras from twenty-seven equal ones to twenty-eight with Abhijit
frame.precession: Moves every position carried between epochs, and every ayanamsha defined at an epoch, by the models' difference: a fraction of an arcsecond within a few centuries of today, more in antiquity
frame.nutation: Moves every apparent position by the series' difference: under a milliarcsecond between IAU 2000B and IAU 2000A
frame.frameBias: Moves every position by the biases' difference, at most the bias itself, about 0.02″

houses.placementSystem: Changes which house each graha stands in, and the cusps
houses.chalitSystem: Changes the bhava chalit: which bhava a graha near a sign's edge falls in
houses.moduleOverrides: Changes the house system one module reads in place of the placement system
houses.polarPolicy: Changes what a house system with no solution inside the polar circles answers: a refusal or another system's houses

day.sunrise: Moves sunrise by a minute or more, and with it every limb read at sunrise and every span measured from it
day.dayBoundary: Moves where the day begins, and so which day an instant falls on
day.polarDayPolicy: Changes what a day without a sunrise is: undefined, from the nearest rise or set, or from midnight
day.ghatiReckoning: Changes a ghati from 24 minutes to a sixtieth of the actual day and night
day.horaReckoning: Changes the horas from twelve proportional parts of the day and of the night to equal hours
day.horizon: Moves every rising and setting by the horizons' difference: a dip or a raised horizon by minutes, the refraction formula or the disc by seconds

panchanga.centre: Moves the day's Moon by up to about a degree, and a limb's end by up to two hours
panchanga.moonEvents: Changes the window the Moon's rise and set are found in
panchanga.muhurtaTables: Changes which muhurta yogas a day holds
panchanga.panchakaStart: Moves the start of panchaka by the first half of Dhanishtha, about half a day
panchanga.panchakaName: Changes whether a panchaka is named by the weekday it begins on
panchanga.shivaVasa: Changes whether each tithi's Shiva vasa is given
panchanga.amritKalam: Moves each nakshatra's amrita kalam window
panchanga.lagnaTable: Moves the day's lagna table to another ascendant, by minutes
panchanga.durmuhurta: Changes which muhurtas of each weekday are durmuhurtas
panchanga.punyaKala: Changes how many ghatis around each sankranti are its punya kala
panchanga.ritu: Changes which season a day falls in, by up to a month
panchanga.solarMonthStart: Moves a solar month's first day, and its season's, by a day
panchanga.eclipseShadow: Changes the Earth's shadow, and so a lunar eclipse's contacts by a minute or so
panchanga.eclipseHorizon: Changes where an eclipse is seen to rise or set, and so whether it counts
panchanga.eclipseVedha: Changes how many hours before an eclipse its vedha begins

time.dstGap: Changes what a civil time the clocks skipped answers: a refusal or the time an hour later
time.dstOverlap: Changes which of two instants a civil time the clocks show twice means, an hour apart
time.unknownTime: Changes what a birth without a time answers: a refusal, or noon, sunrise or midnight
time.deltaT: Moves every instant on Terrestrial Time by the difference between the models: seconds today, minutes or hours in antiquity
time.dut1: Moves every instant on UT1 by up to 0.9 s, and with it sunrise and every limb's end by as much
time.siderealTime: Moves the lagna and the cusps by the models' difference in sidereal time: a fraction of an arcsecond

dasha.balance: Changes the first dasha's balance, and every date after it
dasha.yearLength: Changes the length of a dasha year, and so every date: 360 days against 365.25 moves a date by about 21 months over 120 years
dasha.depth: Changes how many levels of periods a dasha answers
dasha.seedOverflow: Changes what a conditional dasha seeded outside its cycle answers: its start or a refusal
dasha.ashtottariGrouping: Changes which nakshatras each Ashtottari lord holds, and so the birth's first lord
dasha.birthPeriod: Changes the birth period's sub-periods: compressed into the balance or elapsed
dasha.afterCycle: Changes whether a dasha answers past the end of its cycle
dasha.kalachakraMembership: Changes which pada table a nakshatra takes in the Kalachakra dasha
dasha.kalachakraBalance: Changes the Kalachakra balance at birth
dasha.kalachakraAfterNinth: Changes what follows the ninth Kalachakra mahadasha
dasha.shantaSign: Changes which signs make a dasha favourable
dasha.dualLord: Changes the stronger lord of Scorpio and Aquarius in the rashi dashas, and with it their years
dasha.rashiStart: Changes the sign a Mandooka, Shoola or Trikona dasha starts from
dasha.releasingSharedSign: Changes where releasing from Daimon begins at a new or full moon
dasha.firdariaNodes: Moves the nodes' years in a night birth's firdaria
dasha.decennialDivision: Changes how the decennials divide a period below the second level
dasha.karakaDivision: Changes how the Karaka dasha divides a period among its sub-periods
dasha.strongestGraha: Changes which graha is the strongest where a dasha begins from it
dasha.ayurdayaPlace: Changes which body takes a share in an ayurdaya dasha's sub-periods
dasha.naisargikaDivision: Changes how the Naisargika dasha divides a period
dasha.ayurdayaSpan: Changes which span's years an ayurdaya dasha runs
dasha.ayurdayaReadings: Changes the reductions that give the ayurdaya dashas' years

jaimini.charaKarakas: Changes whether seven or eight chara karakas are ranked, and so the Atmakaraka's karakamsha
jaimini.eightKarakaOrder: Changes which karaka each rank carries when eight are ranked
jaimini.nodeCoLordship: Changes which lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th the Brahma graha is chosen among
jaimini.brahma: Changes the rule the Brahma graha is found by
jaimini.grahaArudhaException: Changes whether a graha's arudha moves as a bhava's does
jaimini.sevenKarakaOrder: Moves which karaka each rank names when seven are counted; the ranking itself does not move

gochar.nodeVedha: Changes whether the nodes' transits can be obstructed as the Sun's are
gochar.nodeObstruction: Changes whether the nodes obstruct another graha's transit
gochar.ashtakavargaGoodFrom: Changes how many bindus make a transit good: four or five
gochar.transitCentre: Moves a transiting Moon by up to about a degree between the Earth's centre and the place

kp.rulingCount: Changes how many ruling planets are counted: five, or seven with the sub lords
kp.dayLordDay: Changes the ruling day lord between sunrise and midnight
kp.nodeRulers: Changes when a node joins the ruling planets as an agent
kp.retrogradeRejection: Changes which ruling planets a retrograde planet rejects

aspect.nodeAspects: Changes which houses Rahu and Ketu aspect
aspect.drishtiTable: Changes the strength of each graha's aspect by distance

state.combustionOrbs: Changes how near the Sun a graha is combust, and whether deeply
state.sayanadiGhatis: Changes each graha's Sayanadi avastha by the count of the ghatis of birth
state.sayanadiNodes: Changes Rahu's and Ketu's Sayanadi avasthas
state.pushkaraBhaga: Changes which degrees are pushkara bhagas, and for which grahas
state.maranaSaturn: Changes where Saturn is in his marana karaka sthana
state.maranaVenus: Changes where Venus is in her marana karaka sthana

strength.balaScheme: Changes which components the Shadbala counts
strength.ekadhipatya: Changes the Ashtakavarga's bindus after the Ekadhipatya reduction
strength.shodhana: Changes where the Ashtakavarga's reductions and pindas are made
strength.moonBinduFromJupiter: Moves a bindu of the Moon's Ashtakavarga, and so her transits
strength.preDawnNight: Changes the night a birth before sunrise is measured in
strength.luminaryCheshta: Changes the Sun's and the Moon's Cheshta balas
strength.kranti: Changes the declination the Ayana bala reads
strength.kaalaLords: Changes the year's and the month's lords, and their Kaala bala
strength.naisargika: Changes the natural strengths by hundredths of a virupa
strength.requiredRupas: Changes the rupas a graha's Shadbala must reach to be strong
strength.drekkana: Changes which decanate gives each gender its Drekkana bala
strength.benefics: Changes which grahas count as benefics for the Paksha and Drik balas
strength.cheshta: Changes the Cheshta bala of Mars to Saturn
strength.yuddha: Changes whether grahas at war gain and lose the Yuddha bala
strength.ishtaKashta: Changes the Ishta and Kashta phalas
strength.bhavaDivision: Changes which bhavas the Bhava bala measures
strength.bhavaDig: Changes the Bhava bala's Dig bala
strength.bhavaDrishti: Changes the Bhava bala's Drishti bala
strength.bhavaSpecialRules: Changes whether the Bhava bala adds the special rules

vargas.unattestedDn: Changes how a divisional chart no text attests is divided
vargas.schemes: Moves which sign a graha takes in the chart named, by the scheme's own division; no other chart moves

calendars.civilCalendar: Changes the calendar a request's dates are read in
calendars.lunarMonth: Changes the name of the dark fortnight's month: a month from new moon or from full moon
calendars.samvatsara: Changes the name of a year in the sixty-year cycle
calendars.eras: Changes which era years a date carries
calendars.marginalMonthMinutes: Moves which months are flagged marginal, by how near their deciding moment falls to the boundary; no date moves
calendars.kiratYele: Moves the Kirat Yele Sambat year every date carries, by 1281 years between the two counts

provider.overrides: Changes whose implementation answers where the ephemeris offers its own: numbers at the last digits
provider.tier: Changes the built-in ephemeris's accuracy: the Moon by about an arcsecond
provider.cacheCells: Changes the memory a batch keeps, never a number it answers

output.precision: Changes the digits an answer is rounded to, never what it computes

rashifal.scoreBands: Moves which band a baseline score's overall falls in; the score itself does not move
